title: Safe Deposit Boxes: adding or removing a co-lessee or deputies
content:
## Scope

This policy covers the access list of a Safe Deposit Boxes rental: how many co-lessees and deputies a rental may have, who may change them, and the fee for adding a co-lessee.

## Policy clause

1. A rental has at most 1 co-lessee and at most 2 deputies.
2. The co-lessee and the deputies are changed only on the lessee's own signed instruction, and at the co-lessee add fee.
3. The access list records the full name of the co-lessee, if any, and the full names of the deputies, if any.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Most co-lessees | Most deputies | Fee to add a co-lessee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 | $0.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 | $0.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 | $0.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 | $0.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 | $0.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 1 | 2 | $0.00 |

## Hypothetical requests

| Current access list | Request | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| No co-lessee, one deputy | The lessee's signed instruction adds a co-lessee | Within the limits: 1 co-lessee, 1 deputy; fee $0.00 |
| One co-lessee | The lessee's signed instruction adds a second co-lessee | Exceeds the limit of 1 co-lessee |
| Two deputies | The lessee's signed instruction adds a third deputy | Exceeds the limit of 2 deputies |
| Two deputies | The lessee's signed instruction removes one deputy and adds another | Within the limit: 2 deputies |
| One deputy | That deputy asks to add a second deputy | Not changed: changes are made only on the lessee's own signed instruction |

## Basis Q&A

**Can a deputy add or remove names on the access list?** No. Changes are made only on the lessee's own signed instruction.

**Is there a charge to add a co-lessee?** The co-lessee add fee is $0.00 for every box size.

**How many people besides the lessee can be on the access list?** At most one co-lessee and two deputies.
